name: Zamzummims
overview: The Zamzummims, also known as the Zuzims, were a formidable race of giants who inhabited the land before the Israelites. Scripture describes them as great, numerous, and tall, comparable to the Anakims, but God sovereignly destroyed them to make way for His people. Their presence highlights the challenges faced by Israel in possessing the Promised Land and underscores God's power in delivering His covenant promises.
